voices.name: l00
voices.text: Can't sleep, <#0.2#> so you're scrolling your phone again?
voices.caption: Can't sleep, so you're scrolling your phone again?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: That's exactly what pushes sleep further away.
voices.caption: That's exactly what pushes sleep further away.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Instead, remember three numbers. <#0.4#> Four. <#0.2#> Seven. <#0.2#> Eight.
voices.caption: Instead, remember three numbers: 4, 7, 8

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Breathe in through your nose for four, <#0.3#> hold for seven, <#0.3#> breathe out through your mouth for eight.
voices.caption: In for 4 → hold for 7 → out for 8

voices.name: l04
voices.text: That long exhale tells your body, <#0.2#> you're safe now. <#0.2#> You can sleep.
voices.caption: That long exhale tells your body, you're safe now. You can sleep.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: Just four rounds. <#0.2#> If you lose count, <#0.2#> sleep is already on its way.
voices.caption: Just four rounds. If you lose count, sleep is already on its way.
